title: Marlowe Rewards Member Percentage on Return Restocking
content:
Marlowe Rewards members receive restocking relief on Returns & Exchanges returns. The restocking percentage on grade B units starts from a member percentage set by the returning customer's Marlowe Rewards membership in status active; the membership is never read on a Gift Return.

## Member percentage

| Returning customer's Marlowe Rewards membership | Member percentage |
|---|---|
| In status active, its tier carries the restocking fee waiver perk, and it has held that tier since on or before the return's authorization date (not a Gift Return) | No restocking fee at all: the fee is 0.00 |
| In status active at Marlowe Rewards Gold, enrolled at least 60 calendar months before today (not a Gift Return) | 10 percent |
| Any other customer, and every Gift Return | The return type's grade B restocking percentage |

The rows are read in order: the waiver row first, then the Gold row.

## Boundaries

| Fact | Result |
|---|---|
| Waiver tier started on the authorization date | Held since on or before that date: no restocking fee |
| Waiver tier started the day after the authorization date | Not held on the authorization date: the waiver row does not apply |
| Gold, enrolled exactly 60 calendar months before today | 10 percent |
| Gold, enrolled 59 calendar months before today | Not the Gold row: the return type's grade B percentage |
| Gift Return, whoever's membership | The return type's grade B percentage |

The records read are the Marlowe Rewards membership in status active: its tier, the date that tier started, its enrolment date and whether the tier carries the restocking fee waiver perk.

Example (hypothetical): a Marlowe Rewards Gold member enrolled six years ago returns a grade B shirt on a Store Credit Return; the member percentage is 10 percent.
